description: Wrap native tokens (ETH, AVAX, BNB, POL, PLS) into their wrapped ERC-20 version (WETH, WAVAX, etc.). Required for most DeFi protocols that use ERC-20 tokens instead of raw native tokens. Specify amount in human-readable format (e.g. "0.5" for 0.5 ETH).

amount.description: Amount to wrap in human-readable format (e.g. "0.5")

name: wrap_eth
